4	package storage // import "miniflux.app/v2/internal/storage"
5	
6	import (
7		"database/sql"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"log/slog"
11		"time"
12	
13		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/crypto"

17	)
18	
19	// ErrEntryTombstoned is returned when an entry cannot be created because its
20	// (feed_id, hash) pair has a tombstone recording a prior deletion.
21	var ErrEntryTombstoned = errors.New("store: entry is tombstoned")
22	
23	// CountAllEntries returns the number of entries for each status in the database.
24	// @effects: reads entries
25	func (s *Storage) CountAllEntries() (map[string]int64, error) {
26		rows, err := s.db.Query(`SELECT status, count(*) FROM entries GROUP BY status`)
27		if err != nil {
28			return nil, fmt.Errorf("storage: unable to count entries: %w", err)
29		}
30		defer rows.Close()
31	
32		results := make(map[string]int64)
33		results[model.EntryStatusUnread] = 0
34		results[model.EntryStatusRead] = 0
35	
36		for rows.Next() {
37			var status string
38			var count int64
39	
40			if err := rows.Scan(&status, &count); err != nil {
41				continue
42			}
43	
44			results[status] = count
45		}
46	
47		results["total"] = results[model.EntryStatusUnread] + results[model.EntryStatusRead]
48		return results, nil
49	}
50	
51	// UpdateEntryTitleAndContent updates entry title and content.
52	// @effects: writes entries
53	func (s *Storage) UpdateEntryTitleAndContent(entry *model.Entry) error {
54		truncatedTitle, truncatedContent := truncateTitleAndContentForTSVectorField(entry.Title, entry.Content)
55		query := `
56			UPDATE
57				entries
58			SET
59				title=$1,
60				content=$2,
61				reading_time=$3,
62				document_vectors = setweight(to_tsvector($4), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector($5), 'B')
63			WHERE
64				id=$6 AND user_id=$7
65		`
66	
67		if _, err := s.db.Exec(
68			query,
69			entry.Title,
70			entry.Content,
71			entry.ReadingTime,
72			truncatedTitle,
73			truncatedContent,
74			entry.ID,
75			entry.UserID); err != nil {
76			return fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to update entry #%d: %v`, entry.ID, err)
77		}
78	
79		return nil
80	}
81	
82	// createEntry add a new entry.
83	// @effects: reads entry_tombstones, writes enclosures, writes entries, mut
84	func (s *Storage) createEntry(tx *sql.Tx, entry *model.Entry) error {
85		truncatedTitle, truncatedContent := truncateTitleAndContentForTSVectorField(entry.Title, entry.Content)
86		// The WHERE NOT EXISTS guard makes the tombstone check atomic with the insert, so a
87		// concurrent archive committing between an earlier existence check and this statement
88		// cannot bring a deleted entry back as unread.
89		query := `
90			INSERT INTO entries
91				(
92					title,
93					hash,
94					url,
95					comments_url,
96					published_at,
97					content,
98					author,
99					user_id,
100					feed_id,
101					reading_time,
102					changed_at,
103					document_vectors,
104					tags,
105					language
106				)
107			SELECT
108				$1,
109				$2,
110				$3,
111				$4,
112				$5,
113				$6,
114				$7,
115				$8,
116				$9,
117				$10,
118				now(),
119				setweight(to_tsvector($11), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector($12), 'B'),
120				$13,
121				$14
122			WHERE NOT EXISTS (
123				SELECT 1 FROM entry_tombstones WHERE feed_id=$9 AND hash=$2
124			)
125			RETURNING
126				id, status, created_at, changed_at
127		`
128		err := tx.QueryRow(
129			query,
130			entry.Title,
131			entry.Hash,
132			entry.URL,
133			entry.CommentsURL,
134			entry.Date,
135			entry.Content,
136			entry.Author,
137			entry.UserID,
138			entry.FeedID,
139			entry.ReadingTime,
140			truncatedTitle,
141			truncatedContent,
142			pq.Array(entry.Tags),
143			entry.Language,
144		).Scan(
145			&entry.ID,
146			&entry.Status,
147			&entry.CreatedAt,
148			&entry.ChangedAt,
149		)
150		if errors.Is(err, sql.ErrNoRows) {
151			return ErrEntryTombstoned
152		}
153		if err != nil {
154			return fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to create entry %q (feed #%d): %v`, entry.URL, entry.FeedID, err)
155		}
156	
157		for _, enclosure := range entry.Enclosures {
158			enclosure.EntryID = entry.ID
159			enclosure.UserID = entry.UserID
160			err := s.createEnclosure(tx, enclosure)
161			if err != nil {
162				return err
163			}
164		}
165	
166		return nil
167	}

169	// updateEntry updates an entry when a feed is refreshed.
170	// Note: we do not update the published date because some feeds do not contains any date,
171	// it default to time.Now() which could change the order of items on the history page.
172	// @effects: writes enclosures, writes entries, mut
173	func (s *Storage) updateEntry(tx *sql.Tx, entry *model.Entry) error {
174		truncatedTitle, truncatedContent := truncateTitleAndContentForTSVectorField(entry.Title, entry.Content)
175		query := `
176			UPDATE
177				entries
178			SET
179				title=$1,
180				url=$2,
181				comments_url=$3,
182				content=$4,
183				author=$5,
184				reading_time=$6,
185				document_vectors = setweight(to_tsvector($7), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector($8), 'B'),
186				tags=$12,
187				language=$13
188			WHERE
189				user_id=$9 AND feed_id=$10 AND hash=$11
190			RETURNING
191				id
192		`
193		err := tx.QueryRow(
194			query,
195			entry.Title,
196			entry.URL,
197			entry.CommentsURL,
198			entry.Content,
199			entry.Author,
200			entry.ReadingTime,
201			truncatedTitle,
202			truncatedContent,
203			entry.UserID,
204			entry.FeedID,
205			entry.Hash,
206			pq.Array(entry.Tags),
207			entry.Language,
208		).Scan(&entry.ID)
209		if err != nil {
210			return fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to update entry %q: %v`, entry.URL, err)
211		}
212	
213		for _, enclosure := range entry.Enclosures {
214			enclosure.UserID = entry.UserID
215			enclosure.EntryID = entry.ID
216		}
217	
218		return s.updateEnclosures(tx, entry)
219	}

221	// entryExists checks if an entry already exists based on its hash when refreshing a feed.
222	// @effects: reads entries
223	func (s *Storage) entryExists(tx *sql.Tx, entry *model.Entry) (bool, error) {
224		var result bool
225	
226		// Note: This query uses entries_feed_id_hash_key index (filtering on user_id is not necessary).
227		err := tx.QueryRow(`SELECT true FROM entries WHERE feed_id=$1 AND hash=$2 LIMIT 1`, entry.FeedID, entry.Hash).Scan(&result)

330	func (s *Storage) RefreshFeedEntries(userID, feedID int64, entries model.Entries, updateExistingEntries bool) (newEntries model.Entries, err error) {
331		for _, entry := range entries {
332			entry.UserID = userID
333			entry.FeedID = feedID

335			tx, err := s.db.Begin()
336			if err != nil {
337				return nil, fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to start transaction: %v`, err)
338			}
339	
340			entryExists, err := s.entryExists(tx, entry)
341			if err != nil {
342				if rollbackErr := tx.Rollback(); rollbackErr != nil {
343					return nil, fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to rollback transaction: %v (rolled back due to: %v)`, rollbackErr, err)
344				}
345				return nil, err
346			}
347	
348			if entryExists {
349				if updateExistingEntries {
350					err = s.updateEntry(tx, entry)
351				}
352			} else {
353				err = s.createEntry(tx, entry)
354				switch {
355				case errors.Is(err, ErrEntryTombstoned):
356					err = nil
357				case err == nil:

362			if err != nil {

377	// ArchiveEntries deletes entries older than the given interval and records tombstones so they are not re-ingested.
378	// @effects: reads entries, writes entries, writes entry_tombstones
379	func (s *Storage) ArchiveEntries(status string, interval time.Duration, limit int) (int64, error) {
380		if interval < 0 || limit <= 0 {
381			return 0, nil
382		}
383	
384		query := `
385			WITH to_delete AS (
386				SELECT id, feed_id, hash
387				FROM entries
388				WHERE
389					status=$1 AND
390					starred is false AND
391					share_code='' AND
392					created_at < now() - $2::interval
393				ORDER BY created_at ASC
394				FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
395				LIMIT $3
396			), deleted AS (
397				DELETE FROM entries
398				USING to_delete
399				WHERE entries.id = to_delete.id
400				RETURNING entries.feed_id, entries.hash
401			)
402			INSERT INTO entry_tombstones (feed_id, hash)
403			SELECT feed_id, hash FROM deleted WHERE hash <> ''
404			ON CONFLICT (feed_id, hash) DO NOTHING
405		`
406	
407		days := max(int(interval/(24*time.Hour)), 1)
408	
409		result, err := s.db.Exec(query, status, fmt.Sprintf("%d days", days), limit)
410		if err != nil {
411			return 0, fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to archive %s entries: %v`, status, err)
412		}
413	
414		count, err := result.RowsAffected()
415		if err != nil {
416			return 0, fmt.Errorf(`store: unable to get the number of rows affected: %v`, err)
417		}
418	
419		return count, nil
420	}

702	func truncateTitleAndContentForTSVectorField(title, content string) (string, string) {
703		// The length of a tsvector (lexemes + positions) must be less than 1 megabyte.
704		// We don't need to index the entire content, and we need to keep a buffer for the positions.

708	// truncateStringForTSVectorField truncates a string and don't break UTF-8 characters.
709	// @effects: pure
710	func truncateStringForTSVectorField(s string, maxSize int) string {
711		if len(s) < maxSize {
712			return s
713		}
714	
715		// Truncate to fit under the limit, ensuring we don't break UTF-8 characters
716		truncated := s[:maxSize-1]
717	
718		// Walk backwards to find the last complete UTF-8 character
719		for i := len(truncated) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
720			if (truncated[i] & 0x80) == 0 {
721				// ASCII character, we can stop here
722				return truncated[:i+1]
723			}
724			if (truncated[i] & 0xC0) == 0xC0 {
725				// Start of a multi-byte UTF-8 character
726				return truncated[:i]
727			}
728		}
729	
730		// Fallback: return empty string if we can't find a valid UTF-8 boundary
731		return ""
732	}

395				LIMIT $3

708	// truncateStringForTSVectorField truncates a string and don't break UTF-8 characters.
709	// @effects: pure
710	func truncateStringForTSVectorField(s string, maxSize int) string {
711		if len(s) < maxSize {
712			return s
713		}
714	
715		// Truncate to fit under the limit, ensuring we don't break UTF-8 characters
716		truncated := s[:maxSize-1]
717	
718		// Walk backwards to find the last complete UTF-8 character
719		for i := len(truncated) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
720			if (truncated[i] & 0x80) == 0 {
721				// ASCII character, we can stop here
722				return truncated[:i+1]
723			}
724			if (truncated[i] & 0xC0) == 0xC0 {
725				// Start of a multi-byte UTF-8 character
726				return truncated[:i]
727			}
728		}
729	
730		// Fallback: return empty string if we can't find a valid UTF-8 boundary
731		return ""
732	}
